title: Saving Access
summary: What Save access on licenses.access asks before the two changes that alter who gets DJDL (Automatic licenses Rules → Nobody, and Rules → Everyone who signs in, with the typed slug), and the saved state: the save bar gone and a toast that names the change with View in History.
compare: Rules → Nobody: 'Stop automatic licenses for DJDL?' (caution); the change as Rules struck, Nobody added; 650 automatic licenses stay on their tiers; new sign-ins get nothing; Discover stops offering DJDL to people without a license; the 4 rules are kept. Keep Rules and Stop automatic licenses.

Rules → Everyone who signs in: 'Give every signed-in account a DJDL license?'; every account that signs in gets Trial (14 days of Standard, then Free); nobody moves down (38 Studio, 412 Standard, 57 Education); rules kept but off; type djdl to confirm. Keep Rules and Give everyone Trial.

Saved: a slice of the page with the gates (App downloads now Public, no change marks, no save bar) and a toast 'Saved access' / 'App downloads are now Public.' with View in History, at the slice's bottom right.
Phone: dialogs full width, buttons stacked with the primary on top.

designReview.reviewer: Spacing and content pass against the products.overview and products.home references, all four sizes in both themes
designReview.verdict: Spacing and content pass: kit dialogs, diff chips, icon lists, item rows and toast; 0 screen spacing.

findings.issue: 15 spacing declarations: custom change line, outcome rows, saved header and toast placement.
Outcomes ran two sentences each; the saved header and the toast both said it was saved; the toast repeated the save bar's sentence.
findings.resolution: One clause per outcome; the toast alone confirms, in one sentence.

findings.issue: Dialogs left-clustered, 40% of the board empty; long bodies; toast squeezed on phone.
findings.resolution: Dialogs centre in their tile at 520px (.dlg-center), titles on one line; each body is the change line, one assurance line and the rules line; the toast stacks message then a 44px action on phone (.toast.wrap-action).
